basic_info.description: Welcome to Unit 865 at the Beacon, a stunning 2 Bed, 2 Bath condo with a desirable split floorplan, ideally situated on the 8th floor with beautiful city views. This home is beautifully updated with new light birch vinyl floors, a fully equipped kitchen with white cabinetry, granite countertops, and SS appliances, and a generous living room boasting oversized windows with abundant natural light. Both bedrooms feature custom closets and adjacent bathrooms. Brand new washer/dryer in unit. The Beacon’s full-service amenities include 24-hour doorman/security, outdoor pool with 2 hot tubs, fitness center with sauna, clubhouse with chef's kitchen, business center, dog run, and more. Located across from Oracle Park and connected to Safeway with easy access to fine dining, transportation, Chase Center, Embarcadero, Financial District, and more. Great for commuters, a pied-à-terre, or an investment property!
